items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: George, Zeb, Georgie Boyd, Miley Barnes, he was starring at that time, clarinet man.

ctx.x: What about when you were first starting? Who were some of the great clarinet players down here?
Well, George was in that number. George, Zeb, Georgie Boyd, Miley Barnes, he was starring at that time, clarinet man.
Did you work with Miley much?
